014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016import java.util.Collection;
017import java.util.Collections;
018import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
019import java.util.List;
020import java.util.SequencedSet;
021
022/**
023 * An object with {@linkplain Dependency dependencies}.
024 *
025 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson/" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
026 *
027 * @see #dependencies()
028 */
029public interface Aggregate {
030
031  public static final SequencedSet<Dependency> EMPTY_DEPENDENCIES = Collections.unmodifiableSequencedSet(new LinkedHashSet<>(0));
032
033  /**
034   * Returns an unmodifiable {@link SequencedSet} of {@link Dependency} instances.
035   *
036   * @return an unmodifiable {@link SequencedSet} of {@link Dependency} instances; never {@code null}
037   *
038   * @see Dependency
039   */
040  public default SequencedSet<Dependency> dependencies() {
041    return EMPTY_DEPENDENCIES;
042  }
043
044  public default List<Assignment> assign(final Request<?> r) {
045    final Collection<? extends Dependency> ds = this.dependencies();
046    return ds == null || ds.isEmpty() ? List.of() : ds.stream()
047      .map(d -> Assignment.of(d, r))
048      .toList();
049  }
050
051}
